title: unified-rollouts-staged-shadow-probing-autorollback-enhancements
author: Anika Rao
description: Motivation: improve safety and observability of staged canary + shadow rollouts by adding a proactive staged shadow probing phase and tightening autorollback decision logic. Summary: this PR implements staged shadow probing as part of the unified rollouts engine, extends the autorollback engine to consider quorumed probe metrics and composite thresholds, and adds telemetry and e2e tests to validate stability. Design: introduce a new probing stage that sends sampled traffic to candidate variants in shadow mode with configurable probe weight, duration and quorum settings; probes produce a delta metric stream (latency, error-rate, quality-score) that is fed into the autorollback decision engine. The autorollback engine was refactored to support composite metric rules (AND/OR), dynamic thresholds based on baseline percentiles, and a quarantine/quorum mechanism where a small subset of traffic can be quarantined if probes indicate regression while main rollout continues at reduced weight. Observability: add probe-specific metrics (rollout_probe_success, rollout_probe_latency_p95_delta, rollout_probe_quality_drop) and a prebuilt Grafana dashboard and alert rules. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is off; existing rollout specs without probing fields behave identically. Config: new rollout spec fields added: staged_shadow.probe{weight,duration,quorum,metrics}, autorollback.composite_rules, autorollback.quarantine_window. Migration: controllers will auto-populate missing fields with safe defaults during reconciliation. Testing: unit tests for autorollback refactor, integration tests for staged probing pipeline, and e2e smoke tests against local canary harness. Performance: probes are sampled and rate-limited; no measurable impact on steady-state throughput in benchmarks. Risk: medium — changes touch decisioning path; mitigations include conservative defaults, feature flag, and rollout via canary. Rollout plan: enable feature flag in staging, run against canary-heavy traffic for 72h, then enable for small percentage of production customers before full rollout. Related: ENG-4821 (autorollback refactor), ENG-4822 (probe telemetry), SUP-236 (customer incident that motivated quicker rollback detection).
commits_summary: Refactor autorollback decision engine into modular pipeline; add staged shadow probing pipeline and probe scheduler; add probe metrics and Grafana dashboard; add e2e tests and integration harness updates; update rollout API docs and Helm chart defaults; fix race on rollout state reconciliation; add feature flag gating and migration helpers.
review_comments: Miguel Santos: Left high-level feedback on autorollback refactor; suggested making composite rules short-circuit evaluation to avoid unnecessary metric fetches.
Anika Rao: Addressed by adding short-circuiting and unit tests; moved metric fetch to probe scheduler for locality.
Leah Kim: Asked for clearer guarantees around quarantine window and how it interacts with canary weight decay; requested an explicit example in docs.
Anika Rao: Added example rollout spec and clarified behavior in docs; added tests covering weight decay + quarantine interaction.
Omar Patel: Noted a potential NPE in reconciler when rollout.status.lastProbe is nil; requested defensive checks.
Anika Rao: Added nil checks and added a small integration test to cover the edge case.
Miguel Santos: Approve after requested changes were addressed.
ci_checks: e2e-tests: pass (flaky network test retried once)
release_notes: Adds staged shadow probing and enhanced autorollback safety guards: operators can configure probe weight/duration/quorum and composite metric rules for automated rollbacks. Includes new probe telemetry and Grafana dashboard. Backwards compatible and feature-flag gated.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated behind rollout.probing.enabled=false by default; to enable set rollout.probing.enabled=true in Helm values and run migration job. Probe metrics are emitted under namespace redwood.rollout.probe.* and can generate alerts if configured; recommended to enable in staging first.
testing_summary: Unit tests: autorollback rule evaluation and short-circuiting; Integration: probe scheduler + metric ingestion; E2E: staged rollout with simulated regressions to validate autorollback and quarantine behavior; CI showed one flaky e2e network test retried once and passed.
documentation_changes: Updated docs/unified-rollouts.md with staged probing examples, added API field reference for staged_shadow.probe and autorollback.composite_rules, added migration notes and recommended observability dashboards.
rollback_plan: If issues observed after feature-flag enablement: 1) disable rollout.probing.enabled via Helm (fast), 2) revert rollout spec fields to previous defaults, 3) run migration rollback job to clear probe state, 4) if a model regression is active, use manual rollback endpoint to pin previous model version.
